Q-PRISM needs expandable space per slice:

```text
slice N -> Brown-Hilbert expansion -> inject PID-addressable point(s) between space/time -> slice N+1
```

## Law row

```text
QPRISMSPACEEXPAND|handle8=...|graphify_id=...|rule=brown_hilbert_slice_expansion_pid_injection|slice_from=N|slice_to=N_PLUS_1|inject_between=space_time_next_slice|pid_addressable_points=1|backend=representation_cube|frontend=raw_projection_inert|compile=0|interpret=0|fire=0|json=0
```

Meaning:

- `rule=brown_hilbert_slice_expansion_pid_injection`: the next slice can allocate addressable points in the Brown-Hilbert space.
- `inject_between=space_time_next_slice`: expansion is between slices, not mutation of past slices.
- `pid_addressable_points=1`: the injected point is routable/addressable by PID/Host8/Graphify axes.
- `compile=0|interpret=0|fire=0`: this row is a representation law only. Kernel materialization remains operator-gated.
- `json=0`: HBP/HBI tuple text is the carrier.
